title: I Let the Bakery Intercom Catch the Insult They Thought Was Private

parts.text: I waited on a cake at 11:19 a.m. The counter whispered that I looked like I would haggle a birthday. The intercom they had left open said every word to the line. I was thirty-six, holding a pickup number. I smiled at the speaker. "I can hear the haggle." The manager pulled them off the mic. I got the cake and a discount they invented in panic. I did not haggle. The intercom, it turns out, is not a skull.

social.video_title: The bakery intercom called me a haggle — Part 1/1
